Name: Painted Fences
Author: aedenthorn
Description:
This mod lets you paint your fences by hovering over them, holding down a mod key (default Left Shift) and scrolling with the mouse wheel.

To change the color of connected fences of the same type that have the same color, hold down the bulk mod key as well (default Left Ctrl).

To remove color from a fence, hover over it and press the uncolor key (default Del). You can remove color from connected fences that have the same color by using the bulk mod key as above.

To color gates, you have to place a fence first, then replace it with a gate (this is how SDV determines the type of gate for display, as per the wiki). Gates placed without replacing fences can't be colored (I don't think).


[b][size=5]Notes[/size][/b]

Available colors are taken from the vanilla game's chest colors.

This mod uses its own greyscale versions of vanilla fence textures. Painted fences will not respect your modded fence sprites, but...

You can create your own greyscale textures to replace the default ones using content patcher and targeting the following texture paths:

[b]aedenthorn.PaintedFences/Fence1[/b]
[b]aedenthorn.PaintedFences/Fence2[/b]
[b]aedenthorn.PaintedFences/Fence3[/b]
[b]aedenthorn.PaintedFences/Fence5[/b]

You can also make modded fence objects (idek it that's a thing) colorable using content patcher and targeting the dictionary at:

[b]aedenthorn.PaintedFences/dict[/b]

and adding an entry to the dictionary, e.g.:

[b]"MyModdedFenceID": "PathToMyModdedFenceSprite"[/b]


[size=5][b]Config[/b][/size]

You can customize this mod by editing the config file or using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url].


[b][size=5]Technical[/size][/b]

Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400/]SMAPI[/url].

Implements a [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] interface to change config settings in-game.

Code is at [url=https://github.com/aedenthorn/StardewValleyMods]https://github.com/aedenthorn/StardewValleyMods[/url].

A list of all my mods for Stardew Valley is available at [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/895]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/895[/url].
